title: resume_state
description: The structured frontmatter object of a per-agent resume_state.md file (Requirement 14.2, design 'Data Models / resume_state.md'). resume_state is authored on disk as Markdown-with-YAML-frontmatter; this schema describes the frontmatter mapping after a validator parses it into an object (the free-form notes body below the frontmatter is not part of the structured model and is not validated here).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the agent invocation.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the state write.

input_hash.description: Stable hash of this invocation's inputs (resume only if it matches).

iteration.description: Iteration number this state belongs to.
